title: Emotional Dysregulation and Other Psychopathological Dimensions in Clinical Preschoolers
official: Clinical Characterization of Preschool Children With Internalizing and Externalizing Symptoms: The Role of Empathy, Restricted and Repetitive Behaviors, Emotional-Behavioral Dysregulation, and Executive Functions
summary: The purpose of the study is to investigate the emotional-behavioral dysregulation and its possible correlation with the main demographic and psychopathological variables in a sample of preschool children with internalizing and externalizing disorders.
conditions: Behavioral and Emotional Disorder With Onset in Childhood
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

Inclusion criteria:

* Age between 3 and 6 years
* Presence of an internalizing and/or externalizing disorder
* Parent completion of the questionnaires
* Parent/caregiver signed informed consent for participation in the study

Exclusion criteria:

* Age greater than 6 years
